data.completion_memo: Implemented exact-position input/approval/pause/cancel suspension plus checkpoint and generation-fenced no-replay rehydration. Recovery validates frozen snapshot and plan identities before restoring logical tokens.
data.description: Implement exact-position suspension for input, approval, pause, cancellation, and controlled quiescence plus logical checkpoint proposals and replacement-generation rehydration behind an abstract trusted-core port. Resume only from the frozen snapshot, a core-validated checkpoint, and committed cursor; completed effects must never be replayed. Concrete process IPC is implemented in M04.5.
data.title: M03.5 — Implement suspension and no-replay worker rehydration
